html:
The Kuuku Ya'u are an Aboriginal Australian people of the east coast of Cape York Peninsula, around Lockhart River, Portland Roads and the Iron Range rainforest.

Their neighbours were the Uutaalnganu to the south, the Kaantju inland, and the Wuthathi and Yinwum to the north. Pearling and trepang boats worked this coast from the late 1800s and recruited men as crew. An Anglican mission was opened at Lockhart River in 1924, and Kuuku Ya'u people form a large part of the Lockhart River community today.
sum: The Kuuku Ya'u are an Aboriginal Australian people of the east coast of Cape York Peninsula, around Lockhart River, Portland Roads and the Iron Range rainforest.
